name: Get AS rankings by botnet threat feed activity
description: Get AS rankings by botnet threat feed activity Retrieves a ranked list of Autonomous Systems based on their presence in the Cloudflare Botnet Threat Feed. GET /client/v4/radar/entities/asns/botnet_threat_feed
context:
GET /client/v4/radar/entities/asns/botnet_threat_feed
Retrieves a ranked list of Autonomous Systems based on their presence in the Cloudflare Botnet Threat Feed. Rankings can be sorted by offense count or number of bad IPs. Optionally compare to a previous date to see rank changes.
Optional: limit (query) — Limits the number of objects returned in the response.; offset (query) — Skips the specified number of objects before fetching the results.; metric (query) — Metric to rank ASNs by.; date (query) — The date to retrieve (YYYY-MM-DD format). If not specified, returns the most recent available data. Note: This is the date the report was generated. The report is generated from information collected from the previous day (e.g., the 2026-02-23 entry contains data from 2026-02-22).; compareDateRange (query) — Relative date range for rank change comparison (e.g., "1d", "7d", "30d").; location (query) — Filters results by location. Specify an alpha-2 location code.; asn (query) — Filters results by Autonomous System. Specify one or more Autonomous System Numbers (ASNs) as a comma-separated list. Prefix with `-` to exclude ASNs from results. For example, `-174, 3356` excludes results from AS174, but includes results from AS3356.; sortOrder (query) — Sort order.; format (query) — Format in which results will be returned.

name: Get IRR AS-SETs that an AS is a member of
description: Get IRR AS-SETs that an AS is a member of Retrieves Internet Routing Registry AS-SETs that an AS is a member of. GET /client/v4/radar/entities/asns/{asn}/as_set
context:
GET /client/v4/radar/entities/asns/{asn}/as_set
Retrieves Internet Routing Registry AS-SETs that an AS is a member of.
Required: asn (path) — Retrieves all AS-SETs that the given AS is a member of.
Optional: format (query) — Format in which results will be returned.

name: Get AS-level relationships by ASN
description: Get AS-level relationships by ASN Retrieves AS-level relationship for given networks. GET /client/v4/radar/entities/asns/{asn}/rel
context:
GET /client/v4/radar/entities/asns/{asn}/rel
Retrieves AS-level relationship for given networks.
Required: asn (path) — Retrieves all ASNs with provider-customer or peering relationships with the given ASN.
Optional: asn2 (query) — Retrieves the AS relationship of ASN2 with respect to the given ASN.; format (query) — Format in which results will be returned.

name: Get AS details by ASN
description: Get AS details by ASN Retrieves the requested autonomous system information. GET /client/v4/radar/entities/asns/{asn}
context:
GET /client/v4/radar/entities/asns/{asn}
Retrieves the requested autonomous system information. (A confidence level below `5` indicates a low level of confidence in the traffic data - normally this happens because Cloudflare has a small amount of traffic from/to this AS). Population estimates come from APNIC (refer to https://labs.apnic.net/?p=526).
Required: asn (path) — Single Autonomous System Number (ASN) as integer.
Optional: format (query) — Format in which results will be returned.
